Author: Seris
Name: Scholar Helper
Description: Lightweight Scholar & healer assistant for FFXIV (Dalamud API 15). Uses native hotbar proc borders, configurable screen banners, and built-in game sound chimes for cooldowns, raises, Esuna, low tank HP, and fairy management, plus AoE range hover tooltips, an active raid mitigation strip, and optional Party List inline badges.
Punchline: Native hotbar glows, party/raise/HP alerts, raid mit strip, and AoE range tooltips.
